text: title lands merged, bold, larger row; **gtcars** keeps bold run inside cell; expensive cars get blue fill; msrp numeric column formatted currency.
code: library(gt) library(openxlsx2) library(gtxlsx)  tbl <- gt(head(gtcars[, c("mfr", "model", "year", "msrp")])) |>   tab_header(title = md("The Cars of **gtcars**")) |>   fmt_currency(columns = msrp, decimals = 0) |>   tab_style(     style = list(cell_fill(color = "lightblue"), cell_text(weight = "bold")),     locations = cells_body(columns = msrp, rows = msrp > 100000)   )  wb <- wb_workbook()$add_worksheet(grid_lines = FALSE) wb <- wb_add_gt(wb, tbl, dims = "B2")  if (interactive()) wb$open()

code: library(gt) library(openxlsx2)  tbl <- gt(data.frame(item = c("Cash", "Debt"), amount = c(1204.5, -3910))) tbl <- fmt_currency(tbl, columns = "amount", decimals = 2) tbl <- tab_header(tbl, title = "Balance")  wb <- wb_workbook()$add_worksheet() wb <- wb_add_gt(wb, tbl, dims = "B2")  wb_to_df(wb, col_names = FALSE) #>         B      C #> 2 Balance   <NA> #> 3    item amount #> 4    Cash 1204.5 #> 5    Debt  -3910
